title: Canonical relative coefficient maps, units and Kummer edge maps
statement: The existing canonical constant and root-line pullbacks, their derived comparisons, the coefficient-identified adjunction unit, the actual Kummer edge map, and the two conjunction predicates are defined in the setting of [def-pur-conventions] and [def-pur-affine-line-datum]. The named degree-zero coefficient complexes are identified with their single complexes by reflexivity. Explicit equality maps at these identifications prevent normalization of localization morphisms during type checking. coordinateClass is exactly the published coordinateKummer morphism with those identity maps inserted. mapWithComparison is the composite of the specified single-complex comparison and the image of the underived coefficient map. CoordinateKummerNaturality names the exact coordinate-naturality equation, without changing it; the base-change conjunction and exchange theorem share this irreducible predicate to avoid rechecking expanded localization morphism types. The original seven signatures remain unchanged; these explicit transports and the functor identity laws preserve their actual maps and predicates.

proof_origin.place: Canonical maps and coefficient identifications in clauses (1), (2), and (4); the equality identifications are reflexive definition lemmas.
